title: PR review: acme/widgets #42 <golden>
subtitle: Review of feature/golden against main & friends
at_a_glance: Adds a Widget registry with lookup by name.

pr_description.author: octocat
pr_description.body:
## Why

The old registry was *slow* & untested.

- adds `Registry`
- removes `old_registry.py`

<script>alert(1)</script>

explanation.beginner: A registry is a lookup table. This change adds one for widgets.
explanation.intermediate: The registry replaces module-level globals with an explicit Registry object.
explanation.expert: Registration is idempotent; duplicate names raise KeyError at import time.

important_changes.title: Registry class
important_changes.rationale: The author says globals made testing hard.

important_changes.title: Legacy module removed
important_changes.why: Dead code after the registry landed.

important_changes.title: Config key renamed
important_changes.why: The key name changed from widget_dir to widgets.dir.

decisions.title: Registry is a plain class, not a singleton.
decisions.body: Instances can be created per test.

findings.finding: lookup() returns None on miss but callers index the result
README example uses the old API
